title: Ask the reader a question
objective: Use ask to get a reply that the reader types while the program runs.

body.text: Ask shows a prompt and waits for the reader to type a reply. Store the reply with make, then use {name} inside a say line to show it.

body.title: Ask for a name
body.code:
make name equal to ask "What is your name? "
say "Hello, {name}!"

body.text: Run the example and type your name at the prompt. If you press No more input instead, the program stops and reports that the input ended.
A program can ask several questions. Each ask waits for its own answer, in order, and the output panel keeps everything printed so far.

body.prompt: Ask for a favourite colour, then say I like followed by the colour. The check types blue at the prompt.
body.starter:
make colour equal to ask "Favourite colour? "
say "I like"
body.solution:
make colour equal to ask "Favourite colour? "
say "I like {colour}"

checks.description: With blue typed at the prompt, it prints the prompt and I like blue
